hotels.title: Adults-Only Vanuatu Beachfront Bliss with All-Inclusive Dining, Massages & Island Excursions
hotels.description: This beachfront boutique retreat invites you to reconnect with nature by the Pacific Ocean, where intimate relaxation meets effortless exploration. Home to just eight couples at a time, each traditionally designed room and villa delivers seclusion and serenity on beautiful Espiritu Santo - one of Vanuatu's most spectacular islands - where the archipelago's brilliant blue waters sit just steps from the resort. Thanks to a curated weekly schedule of guided island excursions, you're all set to relax while the team show you the very best of Espiritu Santo, from exploring the ethereal blue waters of Santo's Blue Holes to visiting the local market alongside the chef or spending the afternoon on Champagne Beach's powdery white sands. Breakfast, lunch and dinner see the chef using fresh ingredients sourced from local markets and nearby waters. Between meals, take out a kayak or paddleboard, grab snorkelling gear, or simply let the slow rhythm of island life take over. With boutique studios and handcrafted timber villas, personalised service and the untouched natural beauty of Espiritu Santo surrounding you, this intimate escape ensures everything is taken care of.
